logical_identity: F15 attempt is exactly the same U64 logical programme attempt as GTC AttemptId. It is not an independently selectable output attempt.
canonical_string_encoding: ASCII unsigned base-10 of the U64 value; zero is 0; otherwise no leading zeros. No plus/minus sign, whitespace, separators, locale digits or alternate radix.
producer_and_owner: Existing programme root owns AttemptId. The trusted parent creates output configuration from its current typed AttemptId and the existing programme/staging owner identity. Derive the string once internally; external caller string equality alone is not provenance.
integration: Prefer a minimal private typed constructor/adapter taking AttemptId, validating the existing OutputOwner belongs to that same programme/attempt, and deriving its legacy string internally. Reuse existing types. No new random attempt token, digest, generic identity framework or required user input.
filename_scope: Decimal attempt alone is not globally unique. Retain the existing unique opaque programme staging_owner/output identity required by keyless-publication-state-v1. Distinct programmes may each have attempt0. Do not replace the staging owner with the decimal attempt, change overwrite policy or infer ownership by parsing a filename.
receipts: All output/source/finalize joins carry or resolve the same typed logical attempt under the existing parent ownership contract. If the existing output receipt keeps a String, it must equal the canonical rendering of that typed attempt and be parent-bound; no second logical attempt exists. No need to duplicate the same identity into two independent user fields. Existing opaque staging identity remains separate where already required.
restart: Only existing programme-origin full_restart increments attempt; build a new staging owner/config binding, discard old receipts. U64 overflow follows existing error policy, never wraps. No same-attempt resume.
preflight: Before output staging/append/finalize verify programme/output owner, current typed attempt and canonical string binding alongside existing source/generation checks. Mismatch is rejected before IO/state mutation; no silently accepting a caller label or relabeling existing staging bytes.
scope: String representation and trusted constructor only. Existing durable publication, fatal/retired, parent commit and on-disk filename structure otherwise remain governed by approved contracts.
